name: PrintIntegrator Product Design Connector
author: printintegrator

sections.description:
PrintIntegrator Product Design Connector connects your store to a self-hosted or remote Odoo Design Studio backend.

Features:

  • Store setup wizard in the WordPress admin sidebar
  • WooCommerce REST API key provisioning for secure sync
  • Real-time product sync to Design Studio
  • Per-store cart isolation for multi-store setups
  • Custom design sessions added to the WooCommerce cart and orders
  • Stripe Checkout payment gateway
  • Professional cart, checkout, and order-received styling

This plugin is not affiliated with WooCommerce or Odoo.

Third-Party Services

This plugin connects to an external Odoo / Design Studio server that you configure in the plugin settings.

  • Service: Your configured Odoo Design Studio backend (self-hosted or SaaS)
  • Data sent: store URL, product data, design session metadata, order line items
  • When: only after you save settings, test the connection, connect a store, customize a product, or check out. Activation and first admin load do not contact any remote server.
  • Terms and privacy depend on your configured backend instance

Stripe Checkout is used when the Stripe payment method is enabled:

  • Service: Stripe (https://stripe.com)
  • Data sent: order total, currency, line item labels, customer email, success/cancel URLs
  • Terms: https://stripe.com/legal
  • Privacy: https://stripe.com/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin zip via Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin (or install from the WordPress.org directory).
  2. Activate PrintIntegrator Product Design Connector. WooCommerce must also be active.
  3. Open PrintIntegrator → Store Setup, enter your Design Studio URL, authorize, and connect the store.
  4. Sync products, customize on the storefront, check out — designs appear on WooCommerce orders.

See the Screenshots section for a visual setup guide of each step.
sections.faq:
Does this require WooCommerce?

Yes. WooCommerce 7.0 or higher is required.

Does the plugin work without an external Design Studio server?

No. You must configure a reachable Odoo Design Studio backend URL in the settings.

Is this an official WooCommerce or Odoo plugin?

No. PrintIntegrator Product Design Connector is an independent integration plugin and is not affiliated with Automattic/WooCommerce or Odoo SA.
sections.changelog:
1.8.6

  • Design preview requires a Design Studio access token and verifies it server-side before exposing preview media.

1.8.5

  • Distinctive display name: PrintIntegrator Product Design Connector.
  • Removed Plugin URI header (no third-party project URL).
  • Requested permalink/slug: printintegrator-sync.

1.8.4

  • Rebranded display name to PrintIntegrator Product Design Connector (account printintegrator). Removed prior temporary branding.
  • Requested permalink/slug: printintegrator-sync.

1.8.3

  • Design return to cart requires a verified Design Studio session token; price/store/product never taken from unverified query args.
  • Cart store isolation no longer trusts a raw ?store_id= parameter to remove other stores’ items.

1.8.2

  • Storefront cart/checkout/thank-you styling without loading Google Fonts (Guideline 7).
  • Collection-style order confirmation; theme header chrome hidden on those pages.
  • Legacy Design Studio dashboard links redirect to storecanvas-store-setup.

1.8.1

  • Cart and order-received URLs work on hosts without pretty permalinks.
  • Customized designs add to cart even when the WooCommerce product id is a Design Studio mock id.
  • Stripe payments stay off until enabled. No localhost auto-connect. No activation redirect.
  • Inline onclick handlers replaced with enqueued JavaScript.

1.8.0

  • PHP 7.4 compatible Stripe client (no constructor property promotion).
  • Activation and first admin load no longer probe Odoo or auto-provision stores (Guideline 7).
  • Design Studio is contacted only after an administrator enters the URL and authorizes data sharing.
  • Sync log table created with dbDelta, $wpdb->prefix, and get_charset_collate().
  • Admin CSS/JS stay on plugin screens; setup CSS no longer restyles wp-admin chrome or load Google Fonts.

1.7.2

  • Admin screens moved under WooCommerce (Settings fallback) instead of a high top-level menu.

1.7.1

  • WordPress.org review: Tested up to only in readme; contributors include printintegrator.
  • REST /auth/verify rejects store_id when the user has no assigned stores.
  • Stripe webhook permission_callback requires a valid Stripe signature.
  • Shortcodes limited to storecanvas_design_button and storecanvas_shop_iframe.

1.7.0

  • Requested WordPress.org slug: storecanvas-sync.
  • Plugin folder, bootstrap file, text domain, REST namespace, and script/style handles aligned to storecanvas-sync / storecanvas_.
  • Design preview styles loaded via wp_enqueue_style (no inline style block).

1.6.1

  • Design preview opens on WordPress (product + uploaded artwork) instead of relying on Odoo website pages.
  • Order item meta shows a clear “Open product with uploaded design” link.

1.6.0

  • WordPress.org review: renamed to PrintIntegrator Product Design Connector.
  • Enqueue CSS/JS instead of inline tags.
  • Consistent storecanvas_ prefixes for hooks, options, and declarations.
  • Legacy option migration from earlier plugin slugs.

1.5.0

  • Real Stripe Checkout payments (cards and Stripe-supported methods).

1.4.1

  • Auto-detect Design Studio URL and database on install.
  • Re-enabled automatic store provisioning when Odoo is reachable.

1.4.0

  • WordPress.org review fixes: unified text domain, sanitization, safe redirects, uninstall cleanup.

1.3.0

  • WooCommerce orders sync to Odoo with design previews.

1.1.0

  • Initial public release with SSO and auto-provisioning.
